key_insight: Scalarization links interval-valued optimization to a proximal point algorithm with global convergence and sublinear or linear rates under convexity or strong convexity, respectively.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a principled approach to interval-valued lasso regression for machine learning with uncertain data.
method: Formulate a scalarized version of the unconstrained interval-valued problem.
Relate scalarized optima to LU-nondominated interval solutions.
Apply a proximal point algorithm and establish convergence guarantees.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical experiments, comparison with an existing method, and an interval-valued lasso application, but provides no quantitative results.
watch_item: Convergence-rate guarantees depend on convexity assumptions; the abstract does not specify proximal-subproblem costs or scalability.
paper_title: Proximal point algorithm for interval valued optimization problems with application to lasso problem
